title: Nereis Hero World Topology
validation_note: This data validates abstract region connectivity only. Godot graybox movement, collisions, doors, save/resume, death recovery, and runtime transitions require in-engine acceptance. Hierarchical macro-region/subregion/connection/elevator contracts are design data and are not evidence of runtime implementation. Optional encounter OB01 is described in optional_encounters and is not counted as a C-edge because it is a side encounter rather than a new world-map region.

local_resonance_routes.design_intent: A canopy crossing reconnects the high bell-grave ledges during a return visit; it must not open or replace H02, the hidden bell chamber.
Reconnects the erased third street inside A3 without entering H03 or bypassing a main-story gate.
Reveals a dry aqueduct span above the old reservoir; it is a local traversal route, not a hidden-scene entrance.
A resonance-anchored trench crossing under a buried standard; it shortens the risky battlefield route but does not bypass the fortress's story gate.
A high service-walk shortcut links the tower stair and outer cloister near the silent bell; it shortens a local traversal loop without bypassing the H05 hidden window or the main story exit.
A local upper-level shortcut between prison maintenance landings. It improves the cell-block traversal loop but must not open or bypass the A7-to-A8 royal tomb story gate.
A resonance-anchored upper tomb gallery reconnects the erased royal-name ledge to the return gallery; it must not open or bypass the sealed royal story gate.
A rain-reflection roofwalk reconnects abandoned outer-ring homes as a local traversal loop; it must not open or bypass the royal transport gate or H07.
A choirless upper gallery links the staggered cathedral chapel ledges as a local traversal shortcut; it must not replace either cathedral exit or bypass C19.
A high observation span reconnects two ancient ruin ledges above the Church laboratory; it must not unlock H08 or bypass C15/C19 progression gates.
A crown-wall traverse reconnects two upper palace ledges and exposes the inward-facing arrow slits; it must not bypass the throne approach or ending gates.

provisional_content: H09 cliff-cave experiment is a code-present provisional candidate, not canonical story content and not required for core map acceptance.
Raised doorway interaction volumes are now constrained to the visible doorway height; static code review must not be treated as runtime proof.
latest_spatial_fixes: C05 A3-to-A4 moved to raised pipe-walk at x=1600, y_offset=-115.
C16 A3-to-A9 return door is on the eastern rooftop at x=2040, y_offset=-70; A3 return spawn x=1960.
H05 return gate in A3 is at x=1870, separated from C10 at x=1710 and C16 rooftop lift at x=2040.
A4 now separates C12 (x=1050, y_offset=-75), C07 (x=1320, y_offset=-85), and C23 (x=1650, y_offset=-105) across distinct ledges; C06 village watergate moved to x=2220.
A4 return spawns aligned with the layered doors: C12 x=960, C07 x=1410, C23 x=1540; these are the current runtime spawn mappings and match their spatial_contract return_spawn values.
C16 return spawn is finalized at x=1960, near its elevated door at x=2040 while remaining outside the H05 door trigger at x=1870.

Elevated cross-region transitions now preserve the matching ledge height on arrival: C05 A3 door x=1600/-115, C16 A3 return spawn x=1960/-70, C12 A4 spawn x=960/-75, C07 A4 spawn x=1260/-85, C23 A4 spawn x=1570/-120.
C03 A3-to-A2 return now lands on the A2 canopy approach at x=2120, y_offset=-140, matching the elevated exit route.
C10 Bell Tower Drop moved from the A6 floor to x=2230 on the upper/eastern landing; its A6 return spawn is x=2100, y_offset=-90.

A9 C16 old lift now occupies the x=520 rooftop ledge (y_offset=-110); C23 royal drain now branches from x=740 on the supported upper service ledge (y_offset=-150), with A9 return spawn x=650 at the same height.
A3 C16 moved to x=2040 and its return spawn to x=1960; H05 moved to x=1870 and the A3 rest point moved to x=1470 to maintain non-overlapping interaction zones.
C09 A5-to-A6 now exits from the battlefield parapet at x=2250, y_offset=-90; F10 guidance follows the raised door.

C17 A9-to-A10 now exits from the upper cathedral roof approach at x=2350, y_offset=-180; two short platforms lead from the existing outer-ring upper route, away from the ground-level H06 service door.
latest_structural_audit: Raised exit doors previously used a 138px-high Area2D trigger extending from the doorway down to floor level; this allowed elevated routes to be bypassed from the ground. The trigger has been reduced to 80px and aligned 35px above the doorway origin.
The canonical resonance-hidden network remains H01-H08. H09 is listed separately as a provisional region candidate so it does not silently become approved world canon.
Core map acceptance counts 13 playable primary regions A0-A12 plus 8 canonical hidden regions H01-H08 = 21 scene regions; A13 is an abstract ending layer and H09 is provisional.
C09 and C17 mainline exits were moved away from the continuous ground boundary to reinforce meaningful vertical traversal without adding arbitrary blocking obstacles.

elevators.safety: 升降平台连接墓室与中层水道，不直接跳过王墓主线门

elevators.name: 外环旧货梯
elevators.operation: 外环下层开闸后可往返屋顶站；跨区C16另行接入A3屋顶
elevators.safety: 停靠动画/声音应能被附近玩家感知，避免无反馈传送

elevators.name: 内城货运升降机
elevators.operation: 从服务街和城墙维护点双向操作
elevators.safety: 为高低层回环服务，不作为王座厅的强制捷径

elevators.name: 王座厅配重梯
elevators.operation: 从城墙步道侧开启后可在王座厅上层召回
elevators.safety: 只改变进入高度，不改变结局判定

story_geography.name: 边境村庄
story_geography.story_role: 人物关系、补给、村民日常和袭击事件；安全感会随着剧情被破坏。
connections: 村庄防卫后开放的旧排水通道（低位）

story_geography.name: 雾林与山间峡谷
story_geography.story_role: 教会边境活动、迷路和灵视探索的第一处自然空间；高低路线提供绕开强敌或承担坠落风险的选择。

story_geography.name: 钟墓与荒野墓地
story_geography.story_role: 以葬仪、被抹去的名字和不自然的钟声铺设王国旧史；与普通野外路线交叉，而不是独立支线小岛。

story_geography.name: 边境战场与峡谷堡垒
story_geography.story_role: 揭示教会与王权如何控制边境；提供高墙通路、远程敌人和通向修道院的旧军事路线。

story_geography.name: 废弃城区
places: 旧礼拜堂与被删去的第三街
story_geography.story_role: 第一核心枢纽；街面、屋顶与管线多层交错，灵视揭露被城市记忆抹去的街区。
connections: 村庄防卫后开启的旧排水通道（地面层）

story_geography.name: 下水道与旧水库
story_geography.story_role: 承接城市地面与王室地下工程；水位、闸门、低位通道和垂直井道共同构成路线谜题。

story_geography.name: 教会边陲手术所
story_geography.story_role: 序章发生地；主角被当作可消耗的研究对象。空间短而密集，留下教会秘密研究的第一批证据。

story_geography.name: 边陲修道院与钟塔
story_geography.story_role: 呈现教会公开仪式与隐秘秩序的矛盾；钟塔落差与升降机形成高风险捷径和安全回程的取舍。

story_geography.name: 拘押营与忏悔监牢
story_geography.story_role: 玩家看到被教会收押、审讯或用于研究的人；避免把这里简化成纯战斗关卡，需有证据、幸存者痕迹与资源代价。

story_geography.name: 大圣堂与教会中枢
story_geography.story_role: 教会权力的公开中心；玩家先看见庄严秩序，再通过高廊、内廷与隐藏礼拜空间发现被掩盖的事实。

story_geography.name: 王城外围与废弃街区
story_geography.story_role: 后期第二枢纽；显示王城封锁、平民撤离与王权仍在运转的矛盾。

story_geography.name: 王室地下墓室与旧王墓
story_geography.story_role: 揭示王国建国史、被删改的王名与王室知情程度；墓道既是历史场所，也是王城地下交通节点。

story_geography.name: 王城中心与王宫
story_geography.story_role: 最终王权路线；王或统治者对教会腐化的知情程度应通过环境、命令和遭遇逐步呈现，而非一次性解释。

story_geography.name: 教会秘密实验室与古神遗迹
story_geography.story_role: 前半段是人类主动研究和滥用力量的设施，越深入越转向无法由人类意志解释的古神空间；两者必须在美术、声音和空间规律上有区别。

story_geography.name: 深层梦境与终局异象
story_geography.story_role: 依凡人之墓、永恒乐园、烈火天罚等结局改变空间与遭遇；不是普通地图区域，不应让玩家提前看到完整地图。

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 村庄外围钩爪回环
exploration_gate_contracts.player_hint: Show at least two recognizable hook anchors before the hook is acquired.
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: Villagers preserve unofficial routes omitted from royal and Church maps.

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 鸣响揭示但不自动开启
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: Resonance reveals evidence; physical space and story reasoning still govern access.

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 村口事件开启旧路
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: The raid leaves conflicting Church and bandit traces without revealing the full conspiracy.

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 城区地面屋顶地下三层回环
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: A single landmark is revisited from street, roof, and underground levels.

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 王名抹除廊的双重证据
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: The player sees the missing text first but cannot interpret the history without corroboration.

exploration_gate_contracts.name: 终局支线道具组合
exploration_gate_contracts.narrative_result: The ending depends on accumulated relationships and evidence, not a single key item.

exploration_gate_contracts_note: These contracts connect narrative locations to ability, Resonance, story, and physical gates. They are design data only; do not treat them as runtime implementation evidence.
layer_contracts_note: Every macro connection carries an explicit source/destination subregion and route-form contract. This is a spatial design traceability layer, not proof of scene geometry or runtime traversal.
